findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation in document reads
findings.body: When `userTenant` differs from `documentTenant`, this function now still returns `true`. Callers relying on it as an authorization boundary can therefore expose one tenant’s documents to another.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation in document reads
findings.body:
Returning `true` unconditionally authorizes cross-tenant reads whenever `userTenant !== documentTenant`, exposing documents across tenant boundaries.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._

findings.title: [P2] Preserve the exported document label value
findings.body:
Changing the exported value from `"Document"` to `"Document record"` breaks consumers, assertions, selectors, or serialized data relying on the existing exact-string contract, contrary to the PR’s contract-preservation requirement.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation in document authorization
findings.body:
Every call now authorizes access, including when `userTenant !== documentTenant`. Any caller relying on this function as its read authorization boundary will expose documents across tenants.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._
